Bash(powershell.exe -Command '
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$srcPath = ""C:\\Users\\gorma\\github\\kg-velocity\\Kg.Velocity.Api\\Templates\\Icons\\crabAsJpg.jpg""
$dstPath = ""C:\\Users\\gorma\\github\\kg-velocity\\Kg.Velocity.Api\\Templates\\Icons\\crab-optimized.jpg""

$src = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($srcPath\)
$dst = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap\(256, 256\)
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage\($dst\)
$graphics.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
$graphics.DrawImage\($src, 0, 0, 256, 256\)

$encoder = [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders\(\) | Where-Object { $_.MimeType -eq ""image/jpeg"" }
$encoderParams = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters\(1\)
$encoderParams.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter\([System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, 65L\)
$dst.Save\($dstPath, $encoder, $encoderParams\)

$graphics.Dispose\(\)
$dst.Dispose\(\)
$src.Dispose\(\)
Write-Host ""Created optimized JPG""
')

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$srcPath = ''C:\\Users\\gorma\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\ats\\2.jpg''

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$srcPath = ''C:\\Users\\gorma\\OneDrive\\Desktop\\ats\\2.jpg''
$dstPath = ''C:\\users\\gorma\\github\\kg-velocity\\Kg.Velocity.Blazor\\wwwroot\\images\\social-preview.jpg''

$src = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile\($srcPath\)

# Create 1200x630 canvas with dark background matching app theme
$dst = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap\(1200, 630\)
$graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage\($dst\)

# Fill with dark blue background \(matches your app theme #0b1b3b\)
$bgColor = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(11, 27, 59\)
$graphics.Clear\($bgColor\)

# The dark visualization panel in the source - crop just that part
# Approximate bounds of the dark panel: x=248 to x=760 \(width ~512\), y=100 to y=860 \(height ~760\)
$cropRect = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle\(248, 100, 512, 760\)

# Scale to fit height of 630, maintaining aspect ratio
$scale = 630.0 / 760.0
$newWidth = [int]\(512 * $scale\)
$newHeight = 630

# Center horizontally on the canvas
$destX = \(1200 - $newWidth\) / 2
$destRect = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle\($destX, 0, $newWidth, $newHeight\)

$graphics.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
$graphics.DrawImage\($src, $destRect, $cropRect, [System.Drawing.GraphicsUnit]::Pixel\)

# Save
$encoder = [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders\(\) | Where-Object { $_.MimeType -eq ''image/jpeg'' }
$encoderParams = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters\(1\)
$encoderParams.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter\([System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, 90L\)
$dst.Save\($dstPath, $encoder, $encoderParams\)

$graphics.Dispose\(\)
$dst.Dispose\(\)
$src.Dispose\(\)
Write-Host ''Created social-preview.jpg with dark background''
")
